name: CSV / TSV
limitations: Encoding/dialect and identity field maps require review; not a universal result parser.

name: HTML links / prose
limitations: No general scraper; page text requires explicit evidence review.

name: HTML tables
limitations: Merged/nested tables rejected; links require explicit selection.

name: HY-TEK proprietary exports (.hy3 / .hyv)
limitations: Not SDIF merely because exported by HY-TEK; entries/events are not results; unsupported until a verified interchange contract exists.

name: JSON rows
adapter_scope: JSON arrays and embedded literal JSON following one exact marker; explicit field pointers. Ordinary JSON files use json_columns.
limitations: Observed frontend endpoints are not necessarily documented or stable public APIs.

name: JSONP callback-wrapped JSON
adapter_scope: One exact callback wrapping one JSON literal; explicit field pointers
limitations: Never evaluates JavaScript; a different callback, extra statements or trailing data fail for review.

name: LENEX XML
limitations: Not implemented or claimed as imported. Distinguish individual finishes from entries/splits.

name: PDF layout text
adapter_scope: Strict expected-count text rows after local PDF extraction
limitations: Not OCR; PDFs/images with changed or ambiguous layout fail for review.

name: SDIF 3 (.sd3 / .cl2)
limitations: Full finish parser is local; seeds/splits/relays/DQs are not individual-finish labels. Zero altitude requires review.

name: XLSX workbook
adapter_scope: Discovered NCAA historical sponsorship workbook only

name: ZIP archive
limitations: Container is not a result format. Inspect members; reject ambiguous/multiple result files and decompression hazards.
